bold.name: Bold
bold.intro: Heavy letterforms that stand out in bios, captions and chat. Bold styles are the safest choice when you need wide app support.

italic.name: Italic
italic.intro: Slanted letters that add emphasis without changing weight, handy where apps do not offer italic formatting.

cursive.name: Cursive
cursive.intro: Script alphabets with a handwritten feel, popular for names, invitations and social profiles.

gothic.name: Gothic
gothic.intro: Blackletter styles with a medieval look. They read best at larger sizes and short phrases.

outline.name: Outline
outline.intro: Hollow, double-struck letters that look drawn with a pen. Good for headings and usernames.

clean.name: Clean
clean.intro: Sans-serif and monospace alphabets for a tidy, modern or technical look.

wide.name: Wide
wide.intro: Fullwidth letters with extra spacing, the look behind aesthetic and vaporwave text.

bubble.name: Bubble and boxed
bubble.intro: Letters inside circles, squares or parentheses. Support differs between apps, so test before you post.

small.name: Small and tiny
small.intro: Small capitals, superscript and subscript for tiny, delicate text.

lines.name: Lines
lines.intro: Underlines, strikethroughs, waves, dots and stacked line effects that work on plain letters by adding combining marks.

flip.name: Flip and reverse
flip.intro: Upside-down, backwards and word-reversed text built from rotated glyphs, mirrored order and per-letter flips.

glitch.name: Glitch
glitch.intro: Zalgo-style stacked marks in every intensity, plus corrupted and static variants for a distorted look. Always check how it displays before posting.

decorated.name: Decorated
decorated.intro: Plain letters dressed up with symbol sprinkles, frames, cases and separators.

symbols.name: Symbols
symbols.intro: Text wrapped and joined with Unicode symbols: stars, hearts, arrows, bullets and separators that paste anywhere.

emoji.name: Emoji
emoji.intro: Emoji sprinkled between words or framing the whole line, for captions that should feel playful.

kaomoji.name: Kaomoji
kaomoji.intro: Japanese-style text faces around your words, from table flips to cute hugs.

gaming.name: Gaming
gaming.intro: Clan tags, lobby titles and status lines styled for Discord, Steam and in-game chat.

social.name: Social
social.intro: Bio-ready looks for Instagram, TikTok and X: hearts, frames and profile names that stand out.
